title: Touching the reactor's repulsive field

tellings.quote: And it'll produce a gravitational field around it and you can push on it and you

plain: A physicist named Bob Lazar says that the reactor powering an alien craft he worked on produced a field around itself that you could physically push against with your hand. Lazar tells Michels this from his own claimed work between 1987 and 1989 at a secret site in Nevada he calls S4: "it'll produce a gravitational field around it and you can push on it." If true, it would mean a working device that bends gravity was sitting in a US government lab.
